 import seaborn as sns
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 # Drop non-numeric column(s)
 iris_numeric = iris.drop(columns=['Species'])
 # Set figure size
 plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))
 # Plot heatmap
 sns.heatmap(
    iris_numeric.corr(), 
    annot=True,
    cmap='cubehelix',
    linewidths=1,
    linecolor='k',
    square=True,
    vmin=-1,
    vmax=1,
    cbar_kws={"orientation": "vertical"},
    cbar=True
 )
 plt.title("Correlation Heatmap of Iris Numeric Features")
 plt.show()

In [40]:
# Create a 2x2 grid of subplots
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 10))
# Plotting each feature using Seaborn boxplot
sns.boxplot(x='Species', y='SepalLengthCm', data=iris, ax=ax[0][0])
sns.boxplot(x='Species', y='SepalWidthCm', data=iris, ax=ax[0][1])
sns.boxplot(x='Species', y='PetalLengthCm', data=iris, ax=ax[1][0])
sns.boxplot(x='Species', y='PetalWidthCm', data=iris, ax=ax[1][1])
# Optional: Add titles to each subplot
ax[0][0].set_title('Sepal Length by Species')
ax[0][1].set_title('Sepal Width by Species')
ax[1][0].set_title('Petal Length by Species')
ax[1][1].set_title('Petal Width by Species')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

In [44]:
# Filter for Iris-setosa species
sub = iris[iris['Species'] == 'Iris-setosa']

# Create 2D KDE plot
sns.kdeplot(
    x=sub['SepalLengthCm'],
    y=sub['SepalWidthCm'],
    cmap="plasma",
    fill=True,  # replaces shade=True
    thresh=0    # ensures full shading
)

# Plot labels and title
plt.title('Iris-setosa')
plt.xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)')
plt.ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)')
plt.show()
In [45]:
sns.set_style('darkgrid')
f, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 15))

# Boxplot
sns.boxplot(x="Species", y="PetalLengthCm", data=iris, ax=axes[0, 0])

# Violin plot
sns.violinplot(x='Species', y='PetalLengthCm', data=iris, ax=axes[0, 1])

# Strip plot
sns.stripplot(x='Species', y='SepalLengthCm', data=iris,
              jitter=True, edgecolor='gray', size=8,
              palette='winter', orient='v', ax=axes[1, 0])

# Histogram — corrected this line
axes[1, 1].hist(iris['PetalLengthCm'], bins=100, color='teal', edgecolor='black')

# Optional: Set a title for the whole figure
f.suptitle('Iris Dataset Visualizations', fontsize=16)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

In [47]:
iris['Species'] = iris['Species'].astype('category')

list1 = []
mylabels = []

# Grouping data by species
for gen in iris['Species'].cat.categories:
    list1.append(iris[iris['Species'] == gen]['SepalLengthCm'])
    mylabels.append(gen)

# Plot stacked histogram
plt.hist(list1, bins=30, stacked=True, rwidth=1, label=mylabels)
plt.xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Stacked Histogram of Sepal Length by Species')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
